plan.title: eRFX Auction Required and Optional Terms Acceptance

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen, which defaults to an Auction stage.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow the vendor to be added during event creation.
Apply an Auction template before adding line items.
Complete the Auction pricing sheet so the event can be published.

args.goal: on the Auction stage, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", set "Payment within 45 days" to Required, leave "Delivery within 7 days" as None, click Done, and stop when the saved terms configuration is visible

steps.note: Configure the event-wise/stage-wise clauses and their required status, which has no dedicated catalog action.
Invite one QA test vendor for Vendor A's bidding session.
Verify that the event reached a real published project page.
Open the invited vendor's supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open this event's Auction pricing round in the vendor portal.
Accept the optional clause as required by the scenario.
Quote 100 for every line and submit the vendor bid.
Verify that the bid was submitted after both clauses were accepted.
